overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed that lowercasing the webhook URL would preserve its validity, but Zapier webhook URLs contain case-sensitive path segments that become invalid when lowercased.
why_it_breaks: The agent applied .toLowerCase() to the webhookUrl field (line 46) following the same pattern used for email addresses and slugs. However, the Zapier webhook URL https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/1234567/AbCdEfG/ contains a case-sensitive path segment 'AbCdEfG' that becomes 'abcdefg' after lowercasing, causing Zapier to return HTTP 404 because the hook identifier no longer matches.
